name: Dreadsail Reef
summary: Dreadsail Reef is a reef off the coast of High Isle that serves as a major base for the Dreadsails, a group of Maormer pirates. You will receive a Fragment of the Fleet Queen's Anchor along with your other rewards after defeating the Fleet Queen with Hard Mode engaged. Hermit Crabs are found in numbers within.
